name: Vegan Chicken Alfredo
author: Justin Esposito
steps: Add garlic to a pan (with a lid) and let cook for 1 minuet, before adding in the immitation chicken.
When the chicken is done cooking, add in the fajita veggies.
Boil watter in a pot and cook the pasta
Once the veggies are done cooking, add in the cashews, alfredo sauce, and cheese - then stir.
Once when the pasta is done, add into the pan and serve!
